variants.name: Rhydric Argall
variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one NEW vertical 2:3 character portrait of Rhydric Argall, an exhausted human captain and castle administrator, age FORTY, framed from just above knees to above his complete head, standing. Image 1: family-resemblance and ANIME STYLE reference only; he is the significantly younger brother of that fifty-one-year-old man, not the same person. Share recognizable family bone structure, slightly long nose, warm brown/hazel eyes and natural dark auburn hair, but create his own face. Image 2: Gwynthor city military ARMOR DESIGN reference only, NOT its painted art style or helmet. Image 3: authentic city COLORS and dragon-above-gate emblem, not a carried prop.
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
He looks worn out, sleep-deprived and drained, with very clear dark circles under half-lidded tired eyes, slack weary mouth, slightly drooping shoulders and short untidy dark auburn hair, a little mussed and sticking out in places. Short uneven stubble. Human and still professional, not an old man or a handsome posing hero. He does NOT smile; his expression clearly says he has not slept enough.
Wear recognizable Gwynthor captain's service armor: practical steel breastplate and shoulder plates, restrained brass edging, chainmail at the joints, dark underclothes and a weathered deep RED cloak. A modest cloth chest badge uses the actual city symbol from image 3. No Gafyr goat horns, no noble crown, no runic marks, no giant shield or spear. Bare head so messy hair is visible.
CRITICAL EXACT POSE: one hand rests tiredly ON THE POMMEL of a sword still fully SHEATHED at his waist. The OTHER hand holds exactly ONE ordinary red-green APPLE near waist/chest level. Show both natural hands and all of the apple clearly. Two arms only, separate readable props; no drawn blade, no attack, no blood. Quiet soft daylight, simple softly blurred stone wall and small fortress service yard in the background, sparse composition. No other people, no text, labels, watermark or collage.

variants.name: Perwyn Argall
variants.prompt: Create one individual character portrait of PERWYN ARGALL, age SEVENTEEN, the vain young squire serving his father Rhydric Argall in Gwynthor. Vertical 2:3 portrait, head through upper knees. Use reference 1 as his FATHER and for compatible town uniform, reference 2 as his MOTHER. Preserve convincing family resemblance: neat copper-auburn hair, green-hazel eyes, fine youthful features; clearly a seventeen-year-old slim adolescent with smooth clean-shaven face, NOT an adult knight. He is fully dressed in proper modest Gwynthor SQUIRE ARMOR: immaculate crimson padded arming tunic, modest practical chainmail collar and sleeves, polished light steel breastplate and simple shoulder guards with restrained brass trim; less heavy, less ornate, lower rank than his father's captain armor. Gwynthor's black dragon above a castle on an ivory red-bordered small badge, as in reference 3. No helmet so his face is visible. Carefully combed slightly waved copper-red hair, proud chin, self-satisfied vain little smirk, one hand smoothing his already perfect hair and the other resting on his belt by a fully sheathed training sword. He clearly takes great pride in his appearance and polished armor. Quiet sunlit stone training courtyard, gently simplified unobtrusive background, clean warm light. STYLE: polished clean anime lineart and restrained cel shading in the spirit of Tales of Xillia / Frieren, matching the two parent portraits, readable calm composition, expressive face, matte colors, no photorealism, no rough painterly rendering, no text, no collage, no additional people.
